steers.title: 7 recent losses look like wrong-side trades
steers.detail: Multiple losses >2% of position suggest we're fading momentum. Check if signals are aligned with trend.

deep_analysis:
Flat book (0 open) in a LOW-volume bear-grind — staying flat is currently the right side, and the enforced profit-lock/stale checks are N/A with no positions. The risk right now is not exposure, it's the queue and the armed bracket: all 7 pending signals are SHORTs fired at oversold RSI 13.6-40.0 (KAS 31.1, ARB 13.6, ALT 28.4, BABY 14.3, COMP 21.2, CHIP 35.2, GMX 40.0), every one below SHORT_RSI_HARD_FLOOR=45 and SHORT_RSI_HARD_FLOOR_PUMP_CHAIN=45, so decider_run will hard-block all 7 at exec time — they die at the gate, not in the book. That is the correct outcome: oversold = bounce (BANANA lesson), and the winning side of those dumps is LONG or flat, not another short after the move already happened.

24h book: 31 closes, -$0.59. Direction split 29 LONG (13W) / 2 SHORT (0W) while BTC has been below EMA300 for 721 consecutive minutes — we were over-long in a short tape, exactly the prior session's pattern. Exit breakdown is unchanged and unambiguous: profit-monster-trail 15T 13W +$0.66 (all gross profit), hard_max_loss 6T 0W -$0.70, atr_sl_hit 7T 0W -$0.31 — chop entries that never reach +0.40% to arm the trail can only lose. Recent losers were all mid-band (meta_rsi 32.7-57.6): POL -4.9%, STX -4.9%, NEO -2.4% longs fading a downtrend, CFX -1.9% shorting after the dump. Winning side on each: short/flat for the three longs, flat/long for CFX — none was a trade worth taking fresh today.

7d meta_rsi bands re-verified this run (n reproduces exactly): LONG 45-55 = 40T -$1.75 and LONG 55-65 = 28T -$1.13 are the bleed cells; only green cells with n>=6 are LONG 65-75 (15T 9W +$1.37) and SHORT 55-65 (6T 2W +$0.28). Extremes pay, center pays nobody — but in this tape (BELOW EMA300, volume_ratio 0.59 dipping to 0.09) even the long-extreme band is a counter-trend bounce play, so the edge belongs to waiting for one of the two triggers below rather than forcing mid-band entries on either side.

Pipeline healthy: all systemd timers firing on schedule, watchdog regenerated 04:44, 0 executed/approved signals, last close 01:00 UTC (~3.7h quiet) — a frequency dip explained by LOW volume CALM tape, not a stall. AI Trader pick skipped: AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False (CEO 2026-10-19); state file untouched since 10-21 12:50.

Implication: 0 open = zero exposure while neither side pays; the auto-trader agrees (score long -15 / short +25, regime CHOP, BRACKET). Key hazard: an armed BTC SHORT bracket at 84,888 sits ABOVE both current price (+2.5%) and the EMA300 (83,456) — a genuine reclaim-with-volume would fill it short into the exact moment the tape flips LONG_BIAS. Flip triggers unchanged: (a) BTC reclaims ~83.5k with volume expansion -> LONG side, continuum-trend+ / LONG 65-75 band become the entries and the 84,888 bracket must be cancelled; (b) volume expansion below 82.6k resumes markdown -> SHORT only in the 55-65 band. Until one fires, mid-band entries on either side are the documented bleed.
